Her braids and long sleeve panels stream outward with the stride. Broken pillars, distant ruins, and small grasses add detail around the central figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Sitting Among Stone Forests of Liyue Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun sits among the stone forests of Liyue in this printable coloring page, resting cross-legged on a broad rock shelf with her hands on her knees. Tall narrow peaks, small trees, and a winding distant path surround her. The coloring sheet combines open rock faces and robe folds with finer hair sections and floral costume ornaments.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Posing in Fontaine Court Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Raiden Shogun posing in Fontaine Court, standing with her sword lowered beside a tiered fountain, stone railings, and tall city buildings. Staircases and arched walkways add depth behind her long braid. The coloring sheet includes broad sleeve panels alongside narrow window frames, small paving blocks, and decorative fountain shapes.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Standing Calmly in Inazuma City Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun stands calmly in Inazuma City in this printable coloring page, wearing a long floral robe beside timber buildings, a torii gate, and a hilltop shrine. Her braid falls beside her waist sash as petals drift from a blossoming branch. Broad fabric areas contrast with small flower patterns and wooden building details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Waving in Starfell Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Raiden Shogun waving in Starfell Valley, smiling beside a winding path with evergreen trees, distant mountains, and a small floating creature behind her. Her raised sleeve displays a large Electro motif above its hanging tassel. The coloring sheet includes broad landscape areas and smaller hair decorations, sash cords, and sword fittings.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Standing Among Stone Forests of Liyue Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun stands among the stone forests of Liyue in this printable coloring page, holding her polearm along a rocky path between tall pillars and small windswept trees. Two stone lanterns mark the route around her. The coloring sheet pairs large vertical rock shapes with smaller costume borders, braided hair, and scattered stones underfoot.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Standing Near Grand Narukami Shrine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Raiden Shogun near the Grand Narukami Shrine, standing with her polearm beside a torii gate hung with rope, tassels, and folded paper ornaments. A leafy tree spreads above the layered shrine roofs. Paving stones, wooden railings, and her flower hair ornament add smaller details throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Standing Confidently Near Windrise Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun stands confidently near the Windrise Tree in this printable coloring page, holding her sword before a broad trunk with a small winged monument at its roots. A winding path passes the tree beneath leafy branches. The coloring sheet mixes wide sleeve and trunk areas with small leaves, geometric costume trims, and hair ornaments.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Posing Among Stone Forests of Liyue Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Raiden Shogun posing among the stone forests of Liyue, extending one hand while holding her polearm above a winding river between narrow peaks. Small trees grow along the surrounding rock ledges. Her flowing sleeves and braid contrast with the upright cliffs, offering varied outlined shapes across the landscape coloring sheet.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Running in Liyue Harbor Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun runs through Liyue Harbor in this printable coloring page, striding along stone paving beside a wooden dock, hanging lanterns, and buildings with curved roofs. Her braid and long sleeves trail behind the raised arm. The coloring sheet combines large movement shapes with small window frames, roof details, and mountains rising beyond the harbor street.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Observing in Inazuma City Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Raiden Shogun observing Inazuma City from a wooden balcony, holding her polearm upright above rooftops, winding streets, and distant torii gates. A large building rises behind the weapon's curved blade. The coloring sheet includes broad sleeve panels and plank flooring, with smaller architectural details, hair ornaments, and waist cords.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Portrait Coloring Page — Powerful Archon Lineart
pages.description: Color this stunning close-up portrait of the Electro Archon, Raiden Shogun, from Genshin Impact. This beautifully detailed printable lineart features her iconic hairpiece and intricate armor design, making it a perfect creative project for anime and gaming fans.

pages.title: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun Standing in Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Raiden Shogun stands inside a castle in this printable coloring page, folding her hands at her waist between tall columns, an arched doorway, and a plain hanging banner. Her long braid and wide patterned sleeves frame the centered pose. The coloring sheet combines spacious architectural surfaces with small Electro emblems, sleeve ties, and floral accessories.
